messages:
Maria Chen: Quick sync — can owners confirm status for the console observability pieces we promised for Sprint 42? specifically: dashboards (per-route cost/latency), tracing hook rollout, error-analysis view, trace retention 90d target. Who's owning what and any blockers?
Alex Rivera: I can own dashboards. Plan: wire up per-route panels + cost breakdown. ETA: end of next week. blocker: need the latest usage tags from backend (cc @Samir). :calendar:
Samir Patel: backend tags PR is `#4523` — merged to staging but storage schema change still needs prod migration. migration window TBD because of heavy retention churn. blocker: migration script + smoke tests.
Jia Li: tracing hooks: SDK change is ready (PR `#4599`). Need a rollout plan for mobile + web; also need the sampling defaults updated in prod config. asking infra for canary.
Priya Kapoor: compliance check — 90d retention is fine for GDPR, but we need a data-lookup opt-out hook in the console (audit trail + delete request flow). also KMS key rotation schedule might affect retrieval.
Maria Chen: OK — action items: Alex -> dashboards; Samir -> migration plan + timeline; Jia -> rollout doc + sampling config; Priya -> compliance hooks + KMS note. Please post short status by EOD Thursday. I'll collate for product review. :+1:
Alex Rivera: noted. quick Q — for dashboards do we surface aggregated traces or raw span counts? leaning aggregated + a link to traces explorer for drilldown.
Jia Li: aggregated counts + 1:1 drillthrough link sounds good. tracing hooks will attach trace_id to console events so the link will work.
Samir Patel: migration plan draft: run migration in 3 phases: dry-run, canary 10%, full. Dry-run window needs to run on a standby node; ETA to draft: tomorrow 11am.
Priya Kapoor: adding that delete/opt-out must patch event index too. I'll sketch the workflow and attach to this thread.
Maria Chen: Thanks. Two more constraints: 1) retention config must be toggleable per-org via console flag; 2) dashboards should not increase query cost >20% at peak. call out perf tests.
Alex Rivera: noted — will run query perf tests with synthetic load. can use the perf harness in `infra/perf-dashboard`.
Samir Patel: perf tests — need a short query shape. Alex, can you paste the panel queries so I can simulate?
Alex Rivera: will paste in a follow-up message after this.
OpsBot: Deploy scheduled: `observability-api` -> staging at 2026-07-30T02:15:00Z. Release artefact: sha `c3f9a2b`.
Maria Chen: perfect, thanks OpsBot. If staging looks good let's fastfollow canary for hooks.
Jia Li: I'll coordinate canary rollout with infra. tagging @Samir for the migration window alignment.
Samir Patel: got it. If canary overlaps migration we should queue migration after canary success.
Priya Kapoor: I'll prep compliance doc and link it here when ready. Planning a short async review tomorrow.
Alex Rivera: pasted panel queries now in the `#devex` gdoc link: https://docs.example/obs-panels.
Maria Chen: great. I'll collect all updates and post a consolidated status to product by Friday morning. thanks everyone — feel free to ping for questions. :raised_hands:
